description: Answers a question about quantitative survey data from a CSV and writes a short, evidence-backed report as Markdown to reports/. Works with any survey CSV (column types are auto-detected). Invoke with your request as the argument, e.g. /survey-report <your question>. Use when the user wants an analysis, numbers, a count, a cross-tab, or a claim checked on survey data.
